sentences.en: So, David, four New York Times reporters walk into the Oval Office.

sentences.zh: 我想对于任何一直收听《每日新闻》或阅读《时报》的人来说，说这是现代美国历史上最关键的时刻之一，都算是相当保守的说法了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: I've been talking to him for a couple of weeks about sitting down for a full, on-the-record New York Times interview.

sentences.en: As you know, the relationship between President Trump and The New York Times has been occasionally slightly fraught.

sentences.en: But in the end, he very happily agreed to it.

sentences.en: And we were told that the moment would be 5 p.m.

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: You got a meaningful chunk of his time.

sentences.en: Interrupted some by a few side moments, including the president wanting to show us some of his architectural plans and visit what he's done up in the residence and so forth.
sentences.zh: 中间被一些琐事打断了几次，包括总统想向我们展示他的一些建筑规划，参观他在官邸所做的改动等等。

sentences.en: But a good, oh, just shy of two hours of it was an actual deep probing conversation about this past year, foreign and domestic issues.

sentences.en: And our goal, Michael,

sentences.zh: 我们安顿下来，坐下，围在坚毅桌旁。

sentences.en: So we have an understanding.

sentences.en: This is only used for your reporting.
sentences.zh: 这仅用于你们的报道。

sentences.en: So this is what we wanted to ask you about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们想问你的。

sentences.zh: 我们首先要做的是协商，确保我们确实能把这段录音用于《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you.

sentences.zh: 因为没有那次协商，我们就不会有这一集节目。

sentences.en: Anything for the daily, Michael.
sentences.zh: 为了《每日新闻》，什么都行，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 你能把那个关掉一下吗？

sentences.zh: 这时一位助手走进来，递给总统一张纸条……

sentences.zh: 他马上要和佩特罗总统通电话，这次通话是不公开的。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: ...saying that the president of Columbia was on the phone.
sentences.zh: ……说哥伦比亚总统正在线上。

sentences.zh: 给我个准话。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 当你得知哥伦比亚总统在此时打来电话时，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.zh: 我脑子里闪过的第一个念头是，哦，我们得起身离开。

sentences.zh: 但就在我起身准备离开时，总统向我挥了挥手，示意我：不，大卫，请留下来。

sentences.en: And the second thing that I thought was, if the president of Columbia is calling,
sentences.zh: 我第二个想法是，如果哥伦比亚总统打来电话，

sentences.zh: 那是因为他担心特朗普总统前几天说的话，说他最好小心点，因为下一个可能就是他。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Got it.

sentences.zh: 谈话本身是不公开的，但事实证明，我们在哥伦比亚的同事刚刚采访了佩特罗总统。

sentences.en: So we had New York Times reporters at both ends of this conversation.

sentences.en: We could well get the Venezuela treatment.
sentences.zh: 我们很可能会受到委内瑞拉那样的待遇。

sentences.en: So presumably he's calling to beseech President Trump to treat him kindly.
sentences.zh: 所以大概他是打电话来恳求特朗普总统对他好一点。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the call ends.
sentences.zh: 通话结束了。

sentences.en: OK, let's go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们继续吧。

sentences.en: We turn our recorders back on.
sentences.zh: 我们重新打开了录音机。

sentences.en: I hope that was interesting.
sentences.zh: 希望刚才那段很有趣。

sentences.en: Very interesting.
sentences.zh: 非常有意思。

sentences.en: And that began a really wide ranging conversation.
sentences.zh: 那开启了一场范围非常广泛的谈话。

sentences.en: And in the first part, not surprisingly, we spent a lot of time on foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 在第一部分，不出所料，我们花了很多时间讨论外交政策。

sentences.en: So let me tell you where we want to start.
sentences.zh: 那么让我告诉你我们要从哪里开始。

sentences.en: Your decision to capture Maduro and declare that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你决定逮捕马杜罗并宣布美国在可预见的未来接管局势，我认为这引发了一个问题：你是否相信，正如你的助手斯蒂芬·米勒前几天说得那么清楚的那样，

sentences.en: was in charge for the foreseeable future, I think, raised a question of whether you believe, as your aide, Stephen Miller, put it so clearly the other night,

sentences.en: And I think that left a lot of people wondering whether you believe you have the right as the world's largest superpower to go in and extinguish any threat or seize any resource you think is in the U.S.

sentences.en: interest, particularly in the Western Hemisphere.

sentences.en: If there's a threat, you use the word threat, you certainly would have the right, any country would have the right to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果没有威胁，那就没那么容易了。

sentences.en: Without the threat, much less so.

sentences.en: And frankly, I do believe in the niceties.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我确实相信礼仪。

sentences.en: I get along with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我和很多人都相处得来。

sentences.en: For most presidents, military power is the very last resort.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数总统来说，军事力量是最后的手段。

sentences.en: After everything else, every form of diplomacy has failed you.
sentences.zh: 在尝试了其他一切手段，所有外交形式都失效之后。

sentences.en: So I wanted to get the president focused on the question of what criteria he uses to exercise the most extreme and deadly form of American power, which is the military.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望总统能专注于一个问题，即他使用美国最极端、最致命的力量——也就是军事力量——时所依据的标准是什么。

sentences.en: But also try to figure out how much of a motivation in Venezuela was the fact that it's sitting on the world's largest reserves of oil.

sentences.en: That all this talk about a threat from drugs, from criminals and all that might be secondary to his true motivation here.

sentences.en: No, the oil happened to be there.
sentences.zh: 不，石油只是恰好在那里。

sentences.zh: 别忘了，石油开采需要一段时间。

sentences.en: But we have it set, although we did get, you know, many barrels of oil today, as you probably know.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经安排好了，尽管正如你可能知道的那样，我们今天确实获得了很多桶石油。

sentences.en: And that's fine.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: But we didn't do that.

sentences.en: We didn't even know about the oil of the oil that was being stored there.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不知道那里储存着石油。

sentences.en: So supposing you're Xi Jinping and you've watched the events of the past few days.
sentences.zh: 那么，假设你是习近平，你观察了过去几天的事件。

sentences.en: And I wanted him to talk a little bit about the long-term implications of this, the precedent it sets.
sentences.zh: 我希望他能谈谈这件事的长期影响，以及它所开创的先例。

sentences.zh: 是的，我遵守。

sentences.en: You know, I do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我遵守。

sentences.en: But it depends what your definition of international law is.
sentences.zh: 但这取决于你对国际法的定义是什么。

sentences.en: But the answer is I do.
sentences.zh: 但答案是我遵守。

sentences.en: But we have to keep the United States safe.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须保障美国的安全。

sentences.en: We have to keep parts of the world safe that we feel responsible for.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保障我们认为有责任保护的世界部分地区的安全。

sentences.en: NATO is not feared by Russia or China at all.
sentences.zh: 北约根本不被俄罗斯或中国所畏惧。

sentences.en: Not even a little bit.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: We're tremendously feared.
sentences.zh: 我们被极度畏惧。

sentences.en: David, I found this exchange that the president had with Katie Rogers really fascinating because he is saying that at a moment when he is exercising power,
sentences.zh: 大卫，我发现总统与凯蒂·罗杰斯（Katie Rogers）的这段交流非常引人入胜，因为他在说，在他行使权力的时刻，

sentences.en: arguably as never before, that international law is not much of a constraint on him.
sentences.zh: 可以说是有史以来第一次，国际法对他并没有太大的约束力。

sentences.en: The only constraint, really, is his personal judgment.
sentences.zh: 唯一的约束，实际上是他个人的判断。

sentences.en: And he goes on to say that he thinks that situation, him exercising American power kind of at his whim, is what instills in our foes and even in our allies like NATO,
sentences.zh: 他接着说，他认为那种情况，即他随心所欲地行使美国权力，正是向我们的敌人，甚至是我们像北约这样的盟友，灌输了……

sentences.en: the respect and fear required to operate in this world.
sentences.zh: 在这个世界上运作所必需的尊重和恐惧。

sentences.en: I think this is one of the most fascinating windows into the way President Trump thinks.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是了解特朗普总统思维方式的最迷人的窗口之一。

sentences.en: Because as you just heard there, he views the only check on his power to be his own moral compass.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你刚才听到的，他认为对他权力的唯一制衡就是他自己的道德准则。

sentences.en: And that outside institutions, whether they're the U.N.

sentences.en: And that tells you that he wants to operate as a leader with fundamentally no check at all because he thinks he's a good person and therefore the world can rely on his good judgment and his good heart.

sentences.en: And so we thought we'd sort of stress test that by turning to Greenland.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想通过转向格陵兰岛的问题来测试一下这一点。

sentences.zh: 我可以回到你刚才关于北约的话题吗？

sentences.zh: 如果你必须在获得格陵兰岛和维护北约之间做出选择，你的首要任务是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I don't want to say that to you, but it may be a choice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不想告诉你，但这可能是一个选择。

sentences.zh: 你必须明白，俄罗斯根本不关心北约，除了我们之外。

sentences.en: China is not at all concerned with NATO other than us.
sentences.zh: 中国根本不关心北约，除了我们之外。

sentences.en: Because, sadly, you know, Europe is becoming a much different place.

sentences.en: I think we'll always get along with Europe.

sentences.en: What he's essentially saying is the U.S.

sentences.en: holds all the cards, has all the power, and NATO's not going to have a choice because there is no NATO without the United States.

sentences.zh: 那么，戴维，基于总统谈论美国在海外使用武力，尤其是使用美国军事力量的方式，

sentences.zh: ——北约和整个国际法体系。

sentences.en: It does not look like the ICE officer has been run over there.

sentences.zh: 那可能是因为我们看到了不同的角度。

sentences.zh: 嗯，奥希尔，在我看来，如果你看看那个，那是一个可怕的场景。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: to target.

sentences.en: Even the ships, they go after the ships.

sentences.zh: 你不认为你关于索马里裔的评论是对你自己的公民进行了以偏概全的指责吗？

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I want great people in this country.
sentences.zh: 我想要这个国家有优秀的人。

sentences.en: I want people that love the country.
sentences.zh: 我想要热爱这个国家的人。

sentences.en: And I think that many of the people that came in from Somalia, they hate our country.

sentences.zh: 而且他们不仅憎恨我们的国家，他们还欺骗了我们的国家。

sentences.zh: 他们偷走了数十亿美元。

sentences.en: It's shocking.
sentences.zh: 这令人震惊。

sentences.en: From where they came, they had nothing.

sentences.en: And they come here and they steal.

sentences.zh: 对于明尼苏达州人民和我们国家人民的智慧来说，允许他们这样做是一种耻辱。

sentences.en: Well, you call it whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你想怎么称呼就怎么称呼吧。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，完全不是。

sentences.en: Is part of this agenda aimed at making the country a white man as well?

sentences.en: I just want people that love our country.
sentences.zh: 我只是想要热爱我们国家的人。

sentences.en: It's very simple.
sentences.zh: 这很简单。

sentences.en: I want people that love our country.

sentences.en: I want people that respect our country, respect the laws of our country.
sentences.zh: 我想要尊重我们国家、尊重我们国家法律的人。

sentences.en: And I want people that can embrace our country.
sentences.zh: 我想要能够拥抱我们国家的人。

sentences.en: Because you've shut the door to all refugees besides African-ers.

sentences.en: You have a traffic man on the majority African immigrants.

sentences.en: Very, very much the opposite of that.

sentences.en: People are coming into our country.

sentences.en: Nobody's doing it based on race.

sentences.en: The very few people he is letting in are white.

sentences.zh: 结果ICE把他们全抓了。

sentences.zh: 把他们驱逐出境了。

sentences.en: And I was very angry about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常生气。

sentences.en: You know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because they have to open a factory.
sentences.zh: 因为他们必须开办工厂。

sentences.en: And you can't take a person off the street who's never seen a battery before and think that they're going to make highly complex batteries.
sentences.zh: 你不能随便从街上拉一个人，他以前从没见过电池，就指望他能制造出高度复杂的电池。

sentences.en: He actually invoked the ICE raid on that Hyundai plant in Georgia, where they deported a whole bunch of South Korean workers who were there setting up a car battery factory.
sentences.zh: 他实际上提到了ICE对佐治亚州那家现代汽车工厂的突袭，当时他们驱逐了一大批正在那里筹建汽车电池厂的韩国工人。

sentences.en: You have to allow them to bring some of their experts with them, or they're never going to be able to open their plant or factory.
sentences.zh: 你必须允许他们带上一些专家，否则他们永远无法开办工厂。

sentences.en: It sounds like you were angry at ICE for this raid on the Hyundai facility.
sentences.zh: 听起来你对ICE突袭现代汽车设施感到愤怒。

sentences.en: I was not happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: No, I was not happy about it.
sentences.zh: 不，我对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: They're making batteries.
sentences.zh: 他们在制造电池。

sentences.en: Batteries are very dangerous and actually very complex.
sentences.zh: 电池非常危险，而且实际上非常复杂。

sentences.en: And they brought people that make batteries.
sentences.zh: 他们带来了制造电池的人。

sentences.en: And those people would have trained our people how to make batteries.
sentences.zh: 这些人本可以培训我们的人如何制造电池。

sentences.en: And at some point, they would have gone back because they want to go back to their country.
sentences.zh: 而且在某个时候，他们会回去的，因为他们想回到自己的国家。

sentences.en: So in Trump's telling here, and I was struck by this,
sentences.zh: 所以，在特朗普的叙述中，我对此印象深刻，

sentences.en: that a fair number of American workers just may not be qualified to do the kind of highly technical manufacturing that he's prioritizing right now,
sentences.zh: 相当一部分美国工人可能确实没有资格从事他目前优先考虑的那种高技术制造业，

sentences.en: something like, you know, car batteries.
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道，汽车电池。

sentences.en: And what's interesting about that, of course, is, you know, President Trump runs on a message of remembering forgotten America,
sentences.zh: 当然，有趣的是，你知道，特朗普总统竞选的口号是“记住被遗忘的美国”，

sentences.en: the blue collar working class Americans, many of whom used to be in the manufacturing sector, who need jobs now in the new economy.
sentences.zh: 那些蓝领工人阶级的美国人，他们中许多人过去在制造业工作，现在在新经济中需要工作。

sentences.en: And he's kind of saying, let's be honest, a lot of those people, they can't do this work.
sentences.zh: 而他某种程度上是在说，老实说，这些人中的许多人，他们做不了这种工作。

sentences.en: Well, I think what he's saying is they certainly can't do it at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他想说的是，他们一开始肯定做不了。

sentences.en: Immigrants can.
sentences.zh: 移民可以。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You can't just drop a car battery factory and expect it to be up and running.
sentences.zh: 你不能直接扔下一个汽车电池厂，就指望它能立刻运转起来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Without the help of the technical workers, that they need to get it up and running.
sentences.zh: 没有他们需要的技术工人的帮助，工厂无法启动。

sentences.en: And the American workers aren't going to catch on until that happens.
sentences.zh: 而在那之前，美国工人是学不会的。

sentences.en: To be honest, I'd love to be able to create an immigration policy that works for everyone.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我很乐意制定一项对每个人都有效的移民政策。

sentences.en: You like a comprehensive immigration?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢全面的移民改革？

sentences.en: I would love to do it if it was possible.
sentences.zh: 如果可能的话，我很乐意去做。

sentences.en: Is Congress willing to go do that?
sentences.zh: 国会愿意这样做吗？

sentences.en: George Bush tried.
sentences.zh: 乔治·布什尝试过。

sentences.en: If the Democrats would do it, I'd do it.
sentences.zh: 如果民主党人愿意做，我就做。

sentences.en: I'd love to have a comprehensive immigration policy, something that really worked.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意制定一项全面的移民政策，一项真正有效的政策。

sentences.en: It's about time for the country to have it.
sentences.zh: 是时候让这个国家拥有这样的政策了。

sentences.en: What would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样的？

sentences.en: Excuse me?
sentences.zh: 你说什么？

sentences.en: I don't want to go into that because it's a very ticklish subject.
sentences.zh: 我不想深入讨论，因为这是一个非常棘手的话题。

sentences.en: But I believe that there is a plan that can work for everybody.
sentences.zh: 但我相信有一个方案能对每个人都有效。

sentences.en: David, I wonder if you were as surprised as I was in listening to this interview by the president's sudden enthusiasm for something like comprehensive immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我想知道在听这次采访时，你是否像我一样对总统突然对全面移民改革之类的东西表现出热情感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I'm sure you remember this as well as I do.
sentences.zh: 我相信你和我一样记得这一点。

sentences.en: Comprehensive immigration reform is a word that if a Republican invokes, they are in big,
sentences.zh: 全面移民改革是一个共和党人一旦提及，就会陷入巨大，

sentences.en: big trouble because it almost always implies that you're going to create a legal path for those here illegally.
sentences.zh: 巨大麻烦的词汇，因为它几乎总是意味着你要为那些非法居留的人创造一条合法途径。

sentences.en: That's the comprehensive part of immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 这就是移民改革中“全面”的部分。

sentences.en: In the past, President Trump has sought to kill any form of comprehensive immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 过去，特朗普总统一直试图扼杀任何形式的全面移民改革。

sentences.en: And suddenly he's saying, I want this.
sentences.zh: 而现在他突然说，我想要这个。

sentences.en: You know, Michael, to hear President Trump come back and discuss this, I was sitting there thinking, how is his own base going to go react to this?
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，听到特朗普总统回来讨论这个问题，我当时就在想，他自己的基本盘会对此作何反应？

sentences.en: Because, yes, the core of it is you do find a pathway for at least some to get to citizenship.
sentences.zh: 因为，是的，其核心是你确实为至少一部分人找到了获得公民身份的途径。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure the current Trump base is ready for that.
sentences.zh: 我不确定目前的特朗普基本盘是否准备好接受这一点。

sentences.en: Can we move on to the economy?
sentences.zh: 我们可以谈谈经济吗？

sentences.en: I would like to ask you about Republican pollsters lately are warning that you and the party is losing ground with young voters,
sentences.zh: 我想问你，最近共和党民调专家警告说，你和共和党正在失去年轻选民的支持，

sentences.en: particularly young men who are concerned with job prospects.
sentences.zh: 特别是那些关心就业前景的年轻男性。

sentences.en: Well, I might be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许吧。

sentences.en: Can I have the TikTok thing?
sentences.zh: 能谈谈TikTok的事吗？

sentences.en: But what would you say to those young voters?
sentences.zh: 但你会对那些年轻选民说什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'd say they're rigged polls.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会说那是被操纵的民调。

sentences.en: Look, the polls are rigged just like the writers are.
sentences.zh: 看，民调是被操纵的，就像那些撰稿人一样。

sentences.en: These are Republican pollsters who are warning your party that you are not doing enough to focus on American jobs.
sentences.zh: 这些是共和党民调专家，他们在警告你的政党，你们在关注美国就业方面做得不够。

sentences.en: I can't tell you.
sentences.zh: 我没法告诉你。

sentences.en: I think I'm very popular.
sentences.zh: 我认为我很受欢迎。

sentences.en: This just came out from TikTok.
sentences.zh: 这刚从TikTok出来。

sentences.en: It came out just recently that Donald Trump was number one on TikTok and the most popular person.
sentences.zh: 最近刚出来消息说唐纳德·特朗普在TikTok上排名第一，是最受欢迎的人。

sentences.en: David, on the economy, the president pretty forcefully waves off the idea, which we keep finding in poll after poll.
sentences.zh: 大卫，关于经济问题，总统非常强硬地挥手否认了这个我们在一次又一次民调中不断发现的观点。

sentences.en: And in election results from the last off-year election, that voters, including many Republican voters, are persistently feeling anxious about the economy.
sentences.zh: 而且在上次中期选举的结果中也显示，选民，包括许多共和党选民，对经济持续感到焦虑。

sentences.en: And they don't think he is focused enough on it.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他对此关注不够。

sentences.en: You know, we kept trying to steer him back to this, to try to get him to think about the economic anxieties of ordinary Americans.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们一直试图把他引回这个话题，试图让他思考普通美国人的经济焦虑。

sentences.en: Mr. President, so many voters voted for you because of the economy.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，很多选民因为经济问题投票给你。

sentences.en: And I think Katie just wanted to get back to that.
sentences.zh: 我想凯蒂只是想回到那个话题。

sentences.en: The economy is probably the beSt.
sentences.zh: 经济可能是最好的。

sentences.en: Look, the economy right now, I have trillions and trillions of dollars coming into this economy, more than any nation has ever had by far.
sentences.zh: 看，现在的经济，我有数万亿美元流入这个经济体，远远超过任何国家曾经拥有的水平。

sentences.en: Our economy is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 我们的经济令人难以置信。

sentences.en: And I'm bringing down the prices.
sentences.zh: 而且我正在降低物价。

sentences.en: Remember this.
sentences.zh: 记住这一点。

sentences.en: I did cause the high prices.
sentences.zh: 我确实导致了高物价。

sentences.en: Biden did.
sentences.zh: 是拜登导致的。

sentences.en: Wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: Wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: One second.
sentences.zh: 一秒钟。

sentences.en: I inherited a mess.
sentences.zh: 我接手的是一个烂摊子。

sentences.en: Listen, I inherited a mess.
sentences.zh: 听着，我接手的是一个烂摊子。

sentences.en: I inherited a highly inflated, horribly run country.
sentences.zh: 我接手的是一个高度通胀、管理极其糟糕的国家。

sentences.en: The borders were bad.
sentences.zh: 边境很糟糕。

sentences.en: The military was bad.
sentences.zh: 军队很糟糕。

sentences.en: The Afghanistan was the worst day in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗是我们国家历史上最糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: Maybe in the history.
sentences.zh: 也许是历史上最糟糕的。

sentences.en: I think it was the lowest point.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是最低点。

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: That was the lowest point.
sentences.zh: 那是最低点。

sentences.en: And we may right now be at the highest point in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在可能正处于我国历史上的最高点。

sentences.en: The economy is growing.
sentences.zh: 经济正在增长。

sentences.en: Wages are keeping up with inflation.
sentences.zh: 工资水平跟上了通胀。

sentences.en: But there are other indicators that people are hurting.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他指标显示人们正在受苦。

sentences.en: High earners.
sentences.zh: 高收入者。

sentences.en: 10% of high earners make up for half of the economy growth.
sentences.zh: 10%的高收入者贡献了经济增长的一半。

sentences.en: I'm bringing, they're hurting because of Biden.
sentences.zh: 我正在带来，他们因为拜登而受苦。

sentences.en: I'm bringing down prices.
sentences.zh: 我正在降低物价。

sentences.en: No, high earners are not hurting.
sentences.zh: 不，高收入者并没有受苦。

sentences.en: It's the low earners.
sentences.zh: 是低收入者。

sentences.en: It's the middle earners.
sentences.zh: 是中等收入者。

sentences.en: It's the people that you have promised to help.
sentences.zh: 是你承诺要帮助的人。

sentences.en: What do you say to them?
sentences.zh: 你对他们说什么？

sentences.en: If you look at my achievements, the greatest, percentage-wise, the greatest beneficiaries of my economy in my first term were low-income workers.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看我的成就，按百分比计算，我第一个任期内经济的最大受益者是低收入工人。

sentences.en: And it's turning out to be, right now, blue-collar workers are doing better than anybody else, percentage-wise, as they measure that.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，现在，蓝领工人的表现比任何人都好，按百分比计算，正如他们衡量的那样。

sentences.en: I inherited a mess.
sentences.zh: 我接手的是一个烂摊子。

sentences.en: It was high prices.
sentences.zh: 那是高物价。

sentences.en: It was high inflation.
sentences.zh: 那是高通胀。

sentences.en: It was high crime.
sentences.zh: 那是高犯罪率。

sentences.en: Did you see where murders are the lowest they've ever been?
sentences.zh: 你看到谋杀案处于历史最低水平了吗？

sentences.en: Did you see where crime is at the lowest point it's ever been?
sentences.zh: 你看到犯罪率处于历史最低点了吗？

sentences.en: Do you know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because they closed the border, and we don't have criminals pouring into our country.
sentences.zh: 因为他们关闭了边境，所以我们没有罪犯涌入我们的国家。

sentences.en: Mr. President, do you, a few more on the economy.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，关于经济问题，能不能再多谈一点？

sentences.en: Do you think, are you basically telling Americans that they have to wait a little bit longer, particularly low- and middle-income Americans?
sentences.zh: 您是否在告诉美国人，尤其是中低收入的美国人，他们必须再等一等？

sentences.en: Yeah, it doesn't, I can't fix what they destroyed in four years immediately.
sentences.zh: 是的，这没用，他们四年里破坏的东西，我无法立即修复。

sentences.en: But if you look at it, I have more investment income coming in than any president, than any country has ever had.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看，我获得的投资收益比任何一位总统、任何一个国家曾经拥有的都要多。

sentences.en: What I've done- I mean, it felt in these exchanges that this concept of the president as insulated from the
sentences.zh: 我所做的是——我的意思是，在这些交流中，感觉总统与外界隔绝的这种概念

sentences.en: American economic challenges of this moment was very vividly on display.
sentences.zh: 在这一刻的美国经济挑战中表现得非常生动。

sentences.en: And you don't sense that he is empathetic to those who are worried about the economy.
sentences.zh: 你感觉不到他对那些担心经济的人有同理心。

sentences.en: In fact, he kind of disputes the premise that there is anything wrong with the economy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他某种程度上反驳了经济存在任何问题的前提。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or that new technology, like artificial intelligence, would bring about more economic anxiety.
sentences.zh: 或者反驳了人工智能等新技术会带来更多经济焦虑的说法。

sentences.en: Mr. President, just on AI, there are many Americans who are concerned that AI is going to-
sentences.zh: 总统先生，关于人工智能，许多美国人担心人工智能会……

sentences.en: AI is going to take their jobs and they will not, will be out of work.
sentences.zh: 人工智能会抢走他们的工作，导致他们失业。

sentences.en: I think just the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我认为恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I think AI is going to be a tremendous job producer.
sentences.zh: 我认为人工智能将成为巨大的就业创造者。

sentences.en: I think that we have so many jobs.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们有太多的工作岗位了。

sentences.en: My biggest problem isn't taking the jobs, it's that we don't have enough people to fill the jobs.
sentences.zh: 我最大的问题不是工作被抢走，而是我们没有足够的人手来填补这些空缺。

sentences.en: And that's where robots come in.
sentences.zh: 这就是机器人发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: And so I think you've got to come to your own conclusion about whether or not there's anything in this interview that would make an ordinary American feel better about supermarket
sentences.zh: 所以我想，关于这次采访中是否有任何内容能让普通美国人对超市价格、

sentences.en: prices or tightening job market or the anxieties that come from the arrival of a new and somewhat
sentences.zh: 紧缩的就业市场，或是因一种新的、某种程度上令人恐惧的、

sentences.en: terrifying new technology that's going to have effects that none of us can predict.
sentences.zh: 会产生我们谁也无法预测的影响的新技术到来而产生的焦虑感到宽慰，你得自己得出结论。

sentences.en: So, David, how does this interview ultimately come to an end?
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，这次采访最终是如何结束的？

sentences.en: Well, the president had stuff he wanted us to see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总统有一些他想让我们看的东西。

sentences.en: These are two personnel actions that Scavino's team asked the president to-
sentences.zh: 这是斯卡维诺的团队要求总统处理的两项人事行动——

sentences.en: Oh, I'll sign it in two seconds.
sentences.zh: 哦，我两秒钟就能签好。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, sir.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，先生。

sentences.en: This is a much more important thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这才是更重要的事情。

sentences.en: So this is the ballroom right here.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是宴会厅。

sentences.en: It's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它很漂亮。

sentences.en: People love it.
sentences.zh: 人们都很喜欢它。

sentences.en: And after nearly two hours of conversation, he got up, started pointing out paintings he had dug out of the vault of the White House and hung.
sentences.zh: 在近两个小时的谈话后，他站起身，开始指出他从白宫金库里翻出来并挂上的画作。

sentences.en: Oh, get me the model real faSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，快把模型拿给我。

sentences.en: I'll show up, should I?
sentences.zh: 我会去看看，好吗？

sentences.en: Talked about his plans for the White House complex.
sentences.zh: 谈到了他对白宫建筑群的规划。

sentences.en: All a reminder that while he is taking out the leader of Venezuela and threatening to re-engage
sentences.zh: 这一切都在提醒人们，尽管他正在对付委内瑞拉领导人，威胁要与伊朗重新接触，

sentences.en: with the Iranians and denying that there's any reason for people to be anxious about the economy.
sentences.zh: 并否认人们有任何理由对经济感到焦虑。

sentences.en: As an example, have you seen the white marble floor there?
sentences.zh: 举个例子，你看到那里的白色大理石地板了吗？

sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going back up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我要回去了。

sentences.en: So if you want, you can follow me.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，可以跟着我。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Well, let me just finish this, sir.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我先完成这个，先生。

sentences.en: He's also busy thinking about rebuilding the White House.
sentences.zh: 他还在忙着考虑重建白宫的事。

sentences.en: Sir, do you want to show them the renovation?
sentences.zh: 先生，您想向他们展示翻新工程吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let's go.
sentences.zh: 好，我们走吧。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 来吧。

sentences.en: We had enough.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看够了。

sentences.en: Nice setup, right?
sentences.zh: 布置得不错，对吧？

sentences.en: Katie?
sentences.zh: 凯蒂？

sentences.en: Good?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Two hours, Katie.
sentences.zh: 两个小时了，凯蒂。

sentences.zh: 我可以谈九个小时。

sentences.en: We're going to continue.
sentences.zh: 我们要继续。

sentences.en: Sir, can I get two signatures?
